title: Egg Bhurji
description: Soft Indian-style scrambled eggs with onion, tomato and green chilli, ready in ten minutes and good with bread or roti.
steps: Beat the 4 eggs lightly with half the salt and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan and soften the onion and green chilli for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato, turmeric powder and red chilli powder and cook until the tomato turns pulpy, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently on low heat, scraping the base, until they set into soft curds.
Season with the remaining salt, finish with coriander leaves and serve at once.
